    // True when every pair of corresponding components differs by no more than
    // the given (non-negative) tolerance.
    AlmostEqual(a: IVector, b: IVector, tolerance: Number): Boolean
        => a.AllZipComponents(b, (x, y) => x.AlmostEqual(y, tolerance));
